checklog.title: Checklog
checklog.subtitle: Plain-language audit trail: who did what (sign-in, comments, CMS changes, etc.). Admin-only; sensitive details are minimized on screen.
checklog.securityNotice: Do not share checklog screenshots publicly. Metadata may contain identifiable information — follow internal security policy.
checklog.guideIntro: Each row is something the system recorded. Use tabs to filter groups; the first column explains in everyday language, with technical codes below when needed.
checklog.guideHttpBody: Requests that send data (create/update/delete via API). Often technical; useful when tracing a specific request.
checklog.guideSecurityBody: Sign-in, sign-up, password reset, sign-out, finishing Google login… Answers who tried to access an account and what happened.
checklog.guideContentBody: For example: someone posted a comment. Tied to what visitors see on the site.
checklog.guideAdminBody: Changes in the admin area: create/update/delete fields, posts, etc. Shows what editors changed.
checklog.statsHintRange: Counts only include the date range selected below.

checklog.emptyHint: Try another category tab, clear channel/path filters, or refresh after generating new activity.
